verdict.rationale: Box's Events API (box-docs-8, box-docs-19) is documented as a feed for subscribing to actions in an enterprise, supporting both real-time and historical stream queries — this is Box's cursor/delta mechanism (stream position based polling) rather than a full re-crawl. However, the evidence doesn't explicitly describe the cursor parameter/field name or confirm incremental-only payload behavior, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of efficient delta sync in practice. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the stream_position cursor parameter and its 'changes since last call' semantics, and independent developer confirmation that it works efficiently at scale.
